build_vitnd_model: build a ViTND model for N-dimensional vision transformer with configurable input shape and patch size
create_attention_module: create a multi-head attention module with query-key-value projections and softmax attention
create_transformer_block: create a transformer block with alternating attention and feedforward layers with residual connections
test_vitnd_forward: test the ViTND forward pass with N-dimensional tensor input and verify output logits shape
review_feedforward_network: review the feedforward network module with layer normalization, GELU activation, and dropout
